simple.meaning: הֵן (hên) is a Hebrew object word meaning “they (only used when emphatic).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 19:29. The surrounding context includes family line, offering.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הֵן (H2004) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
